Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 14
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical logical error in Step 14 by calculating the age of the directors *at the time of the film's release* rather than comparing their *actual birth years* to determine who is younger in absolute terms. The question asks "Which film whose director is younger," which implies comparing the birth years directly (1925/1929 vs 1947). Even if one were to argue for age-at-release, the Planner's calculation was flawed because A. B. Raj (born ~1925) was only ~47 when *Kalippava* (1972) was released, while Amos Kollek (born 1947) was ~49 when *A Couch In New York* (1996) was released. However, the primary error is the misinterpretation of the question; the director born in 1925/1929 is objectively older than the director born in 1947, regardless of the release year. The Planner incorrectly concluded that Kalippava has the younger director based on this flawed age-at-release comparison.
